relevant_tags.why: The service includes pantry items in its delivery boxes.

creatives.angle: Highlighting organic ingredient transparency and emotional connection by framing organic produce as quality ingredients to share with pets.
claims_used: Organic produce and pantry items delivered at up to 40% off supermarkets

issues: The seasonal reference ('this Halloween') makes the ad copy non-evergreen and irrelevant for most of the year.

Framing a standard human grocery delivery service as ingredients to 'share with your pet' is highly awkward and potentially dangerous, as many common produce and pantry items (e.g., onions, grapes, garlic, raisins, chocolate) are toxic to pets.

pricing.rationale: Pay per click (verifiable without trusting a pixel). Market price to win a page view on these hosts: $0.69-$0.95 per click (median $0.81), from the simulated auction against the other campaigns. 'balanced' bidding tries to win up to 60% of each host's page views; the planned bid per host is the price that wins its planned share.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded.

allocations.rationale: market price $0.60-$0.80 (median $0.68); bidding $0.47 wins ~2% of page views, paying ~$0.44 per click (second price); host also sells this kind of product: confirm it allows competing brands
market price $0.69-$0.95 (median $0.81); bidding $0.69 wins ~0% of page views, paying ~$0.00 per click (second price)
market price $0.79-$1.07 (median $0.90); bidding $0.79 wins ~0% of page views, paying ~$0.00 per click (second price)

phases.rule: planned bid per host; pacing only
phases.why: stable bids so measured rates aren't confounded

phases.name: maximize
phases.rule: planned bid x pacing x conversion likelihood, up to the ceiling

adjustments.reason: Under-delivering vs the daily plan -> bid up a little; over-delivering -> bid down.
Bid higher when the shopper looks like a likely converter (persona match vs the host's average shopper).

bid_strategy.rationale: Maximise conversions within the budget; the ceiling per host is the price that wins your 'balanced' share.
